title: Halloween Zombie Meatloaf
description: This Halloween zombie meatloaf recipe is shaped like a skull with hard-boiled eggs as eerie eyes, garlic cloves for snaggly teeth, and a blood-red sauce.
ingredients: 0.5 cup finely shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1 teaspoon seasoned salt (such as Morton® Nature's Seasons® Seasoning Blend), or to taste
5 cloves garlic, cut into small pieces

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil; lightly grease foil.

Combine ground beef, onion, crackers, milk, Cheddar cheese, eggs, Worcestershire sauce, and seasoned salt in a bowl; transfer mixture to the prepared baking sheet. Form into a skull shape, leaving holes for eye sockets and a mouth. Place hard-boiled egg halves into eye sockets, shaping meatloaf mixture around them to hold in place.
Combine ketchup, brown sugar, and barbecue sauce in a bowl until smooth; spread 1/2 on meatloaf, including eyes and mouth.
Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center, 50 to 60 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).
Place garlic pieces (teeth) into the mouth. Brush remaining sauce over meatloaf or serve on the side.

video.description: In this video, we'll show you how to make this festive meatloaf perfect for Halloween night. While the base of this recipe is an outstanding meatloaf, we'll show you how to shape the meatloaf to look like a creepy zombie skull! With the addition of hard-boiled egg eyes and garlic teeth, you're just going to have to give this one a try.
